horoscopes.horoscope: You are ever eager to socialise, and today especially, you may want to mix business with pleasure. You will be welcomed to join in group activities because you can work and play with equal enthusiasm. In fact, you may learn a lot from such a healthy exchange of ideas, says Ganesha. Today’s the perfect day to ask your soulmate out for a romantic date. You tend to be hot-tempered while interacting with your loved one. You need to manage your anger. Otherwise, you may spoil the relationship. If you are already committed, you’ll spend a passionate time together. As you are full of energy today, you may end up taking impulsive decisions. Control your ‘fire’ and aggression so that your energy level is not depleted. Besides, avoid consuming spicy food as it can upset your stomach. Also, stay composed and balanced. You shall tend to indulge in speculation today, foresees Ganesha. You shall seriously think about pumping your spare funds into the stock market. If old investments have plateaued, you may think of off-loading them. You need to be very attentive and careful as you have to make some important decisions. Therefore, avoid being rash or impulsive today. Ganesha recommends that you maintain your cool. Even in the most difficult situation if you keep patience, half of the work will get done, says Ganesha.

Light bulbs will flash relentlessly today, as you ideate in the fervour of a creative mood. Your business acumen will help you negotiate problems with ease. The Leo charms will ring out loud in your laughter as you deal with bosses and colleagues at the workplace, says Ganesha. You’ll wear your heart on your sleeve today and will need your beloved for emotional support. You may not solve important matters related to the heart. However, things will get solved by the sweet help of your partner. So, stay attached, advise Ganesha. You will not face any major health issue today. Ganesha suggests you to avoid seeking emotional or moral support from others, as there are chances of disappointment. You should trust your own feelings and abilities in everything that you are dealing with. On the financial front, Ganesha predicts that things will just be so-so today. However, you shall not face any sort of financial constraint, and shall be comfortable on this front. A good day for those involved in the administrative work. Your strong leadership skills will help you guide your teammates. Beware of technical problems, warns Ganesha. Firm decision making regarding technical issues will result in an effective flow of works, says Ganesha.

You will let your personal likes and dislikes cloud your judgement today. Don’t let that happen, or you may lose a worthy friend. You are likely to have a chance meeting with your soul mate or maybe even your ex-sweetheart. A romantic evening is on the anvil. But it remains to be seen whether it will be your past, present or future lover. Since you’ll be busy, you will try to please your beloved through a romantic email or SMS. Ganesha says that you should not feel shy of your beloved’s presence around you. Surprising your partner with a gift or party will be a clever idea. After all, these are the ways you can stimulate romance for your soul mate. You may face some issues while interacting with people in your professional and social circle. Yet, behave properly with everyone to maintain cordial relations with one and all. This will also have a positive impact on your health, says Ganesha. Ganesha says that today looks rather good on the financial front. However, you must not hanker after money, or you may be disappointed. Just carry on your routine work, and put money matters in the background. You will establish a strong association with famous and influential people from different groups. You may also find yourself busy in administrative activities such as documentation. Meeting with different people will enrich your knowledge and management skill, says Ganesha.

Today may not be a productive day for you. Though there may not be any major loss, you may feel a little lost and would like to be left alone. If you have kids, you may suffer from the empty nest syndrome with your kids not at home. Your partner may easily believe in you. You should not dominate your beloved. He/she may not put up with you this time, says Ganesha. You need to understand the psyche of your partner as disagreement later will put you in trouble, says Ganesha. Be considerate and not stubborn, says Ganesha. You should look at things from the other angle, and try to understand people. Act prudently, and avoid disputes – it may spoil your mood and have a detrimental effect on your health. Planets indicate that today is a good day to invest money in fixed deposit or government schemes, because they are likely to give you better returns. Overall, the day is quite favourable for you. Today, you may plan to change your job, mostly because you believe that your pay is not at par with the amount of work you are putting in. You, however, will immediately get some sort of assurance from your colleagues.

You may wear the trendiest suit, drive the swankiest car and dine at the costliest restaurant, but if luck is not on your side, you can forget becoming a business tycoon. Fortunately, that is not the case with you today. With a favourable alignment of the cosmos, you are set for a day where your business proposals will be the hardest thing to overlook. Take bold and cautious steps as you launch your enterprise. Just remember, short-term gains are fine, but what you really want to focus on is the long-term goodwill of the people around you. Keep your ego in check if you want your personal life to be tolerable. If you need to get something valuable, you need to sacrifice something. You will always get support from your soul mate once you will be loyal and faithful to him/her. Certain events that occur today, may not be in your favour. Some people may try to find faults and critise you. Anyway, Ganesha suggests that you should not get upset. Instead, practice yoga and meditation for attaining peace of mind. When it comes to financial matters, Ganesha advisees you to be very careful at least of the big investments, and plan them out well to avoid untoward incidents. You may go ahead with minor expenses. This is the day to exhibit confidence and a lot of positive energy. Your good performance at work is likely to make your co-workers jealous. You need to be very careful of your words and actions. You are likely to get supports from your boss, says Ganesha.

Family matters. And matters of family matter more. Your negotiation skills are supreme and you shall bring harmonious ends to disputes today. Life has taught you to be balanced and level-headed, and you strongly believe that there is progression in opposition. Ganesha says that you may not be well prepared to please your sweetheart. Your effort to seduce your love interest will fail. If you think that you are the boss in the art of seduction, you are wrong. You need to learn it from your soul mate. Some health issues may spoil your mood and plans for the day. Those suffering from cervical pain, or spinal cord disorders should especially remain cautious to avoid complications. If required, you should immediately go for a medical checkup, advises Ganesha. Today’s planetary positions suggest that despite your efforts to save money, you may end up burning a hole in your pockets. You should not regret this as impulsive phase will pass. Today you may need to show your warrior spirit at the professional as well as the personal front. While trying to make a crucial decision, you may have to delay some important decisions. Due to this, your efforts may not be taken into consideration.

It’s a full platter today, and you have to manage it all somehow. The day promises to be full of activities, especially those that involve writing letters and reviving old contacts. Expect a call to appear for an interview for a better job. Also, look forward to being put in charge of organising events at work, says Ganesha. Your beloved will cheer you up and will help you reinstate balance in your life. You will share some interesting thoughts to sweeten your relationship. Painting, singing or dancing will be your interest today. You are in a mood to spend a productive time with your partner, foresees Ganesha. Ganesha foresees that you shall be in the pink of health today. This will enable you to strike the right balance between your personal and professional life. Also make it a point to eat nutritious food and exercise regularly. Ganesha feels that today is a good day to start something new. In other words, you need to building another avenue to earn some extra money to strengthen your savings. Today, you are in a bit of a scramble, foresees Ganesha. You will have to deal with people from higher authority and will have to make sure that their egos are in good health. You should be confident to take the enormous pressure since this job will demand strong attention, the presence of mind, and dedication.

In all probability, you are set to shine out as a man of care and kindness. Ganesha advises you to shut the doors on worries and open the windows to let merrymaking and happiness sweep you off your feet today. The social bug will bite you hard, says Ganesha. You don’t need to bring professional matters once in the company of your beloved and spend quality time with him/her. You will need emotional support from your sweetheart in order to build a solid bond. Dancing or hot yoga with your beloved will create your mood to spice up, suggests Ganesha. With your mind full of novel ideas and your body brimfull with stamina, this is the right time to undertake tough activities on all the fronts of life. Your determination and dedication shall help to easily complete incomplete tasks. Today is an ideal time for switching from job to business to earn more money. Also, it is a good day to hop on to a better paying job. By and large, the day is good for taking financial decisions. Today, you will turn workaholic, feels Ganesha. You are focused and have no time to catch your breath as you are over-loaded with work responsibilities. Your aggressive approach will speed up the workflow. Meditation will help you feel good and do good, says Ganesha.

Providence smiles upon you today, predicts Ganesha. Catching a film with your beloved today is a very good idea. Chances are you may have a nice outing along with your friends or family. In either case, the load in your wallet is likely to lessen, steadily if not dramatically. Travelling is on the cards, says Ganesha. This is a good time to make a trip to a far off place with your beloved. Sea beaches, jungle or hill station may attract you and you are in a mood to spend an amazingly intimate moment with your soul mate. Your oral and written communications skills will step to the fore. This will enable you to clearly convey your thoughts and leave a lasting impression on everyone in your home and office. Convincing difficult people will be easy, says Ganesha. Ganesha feels that today your zest to earn extra money will be so strong that you will not mind taking risks. Today is an auspicious day for money matters, provided your decisions are rational. Today, your luck will be as good as it can get. All the risks that you take will bring positive results. You may want to experiment with new software or may want to design something that you have had in mind for a long time. Your efforts will spread positivity in the office.

Not many can match you when it comes to living a healthy lifestyle, and as Ganesha says, health won’t be an issue today either. On the work front, you are likely to complete pending projects successfully and your boss, who may be furious because of the delay caused, will reluctantly admit that you did justice to the work and that it was worth the wait. While money matters may take a back seat later in the day, small issues will affect you in a big way. After a tiresome day at work, your partner will take good care of you and her/his mere presence will bring your energy and enthusiasm back. It’s a great time to get a soothing massage therapy from your sweetheart. It will rejuvenate your soul. Ganesha foresees that today your energy level is likely to move downwards. If it is not urgent, you should avoid doing tough tasks. In case, you are overloaded with work, the best thing is to seek help of people around you. Today is not a favourable day to set up joint accounts as it could lead to suspicions with your friends or near and dear ones. Ganesha cautions you to be careful regarding financial affairs. Technical problems at work will spoil the entire day. Ganesha says you may want to work out a contingency plan to sort out things at work. Managing the time and efficiency would be the challenges for you. Proper planning and strategies will keep you ahead in the competition.

Today, you will wish there were two of you! You are deluged with pending work, and even doubling up efforts will not seem enough. You may even cancel your movie date, deciding to deal with your sweetheart’s tantrums later. It’s your boss you are worried about, says Ganesha. Today Ganesha feels that you will spend quality time with your beloved. You will enjoy your time, but Ganesha advisees you not to impose your views on your lover. Reading books together and listening to music will enliven your evening and entertain you. The mounting work pressure and rising heap of work files, may cause lots of anxiety today. But don’t get upset, and try your best to complete the tasks. Watch your health, and take short breaks to refresh yourself, advises Ganesha. Today is not a good day to invest in the realty market and you should wait for planetary to turn favourable. Your financial decisions may not be spot on, so tread carefully. Let your superiors and seniors take charge at the office. Avoid confrontation as your colleagues may not like it and speak ill of you behind your back. You should remain cool and keep maintaining good relations with everybody at work, suggests Ganesha.

Bright prospects will greet whatever new ventures you decide to focus on today, says Ganesha. It is a good time to implement your plans. Apart from short-term monetary gains, you may also find yourself pursuing activities which bring you intangible rewards, like goodwill for example. You are likely to spend the time alone and ignore your beloved and this may cause strong repercussions. Your partner may doubt your motives and reactions. Avoid any quarrel and don’t allow any confusions in your mind. You should think for the future and strengthen the bond. On this dicey day, the less favourable conditions on all the fronts may test your patience. But, instead of getting disappointed – try to remain composed. Then, make all efforts to tackle tough tasks and handle difficult people, advises Ganesha. You shall be very rational on the financial front today. For once, you shall be using your head more than your heart while spending money, which is a very good thing, says Ganesha. You will remain focused and grounded in your work, foresees Ganesha. An important meeting may get delayed. You are likely to fix the problems but Ganesha says that you should try and finish your own work first. The deadline should be the top priority.
